I lost $18,000 last March because I signed a contract without reading section 4. The client approved the work on a Tuesday. Nine days later they asked for the money back.

So I changed one word. Payment on delivery now, not on approval. It took me two years and a refund to learn that approval is a feeling and delivery is a date.

If you freelance, check your own section 4 tonight. Mine was copied from a template I found in 2019.
